## Problem
User screenshot of https://ava.rootmc.net/ shows:
- Status: live · hot
- **AGENTS: 0/3** (highlighted — problem)
- **ASKS OPEN: 0**
- MODE hot, POLL 4s, TRANSPORT both, reactions fine, heartbeat ok, CURSOR KEY yes
- LAST ASK empty, LAST ACTIVITY ~4m ago

User ask: **Fix this by allowing her to be autonomous in Discord again when she is powered on.**

## Goal
When Ava is powered on (not hush/sleep/power-down), she should autonomously engage Discord again — agent/cursor slots should be usable (not stuck at 0/3), pipeline should process asks, gateway/poller should reply without needing manual agent IDs pasted in chat.

## Investigate & fix
1. Read status page / heartbeat code: `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/statusPage.mjs`, `store.mjs`, `cursorBrain.mjs`, `poller.mjs`, `pipeline.mjs`, `powerDown.mjs`, `overloadSafeMode.mjs`, `recommend.mjs` (QUIET/hush), gateway.
2. Find why `agents` shows 0/3 while live·hot — is CURSOR_CONCURRENCY broken, brain queue paused, Discord engage gated, sweater/safe mode, emergency stop, or status metric wrong?
3. Fix so powered-on = autonomous Discord (gateway+poller process mentions/replies; cursor agents can run up to concurrency). Don’t break hush/QUIET/power-down/sleep intentional offs.
4. Restart Ava quietly (`npm start` headless pattern used before) and verify `/api/status` shows sensible agents/asks when work exists; confirm Discord engage path isn’t blocked.
5. If status display was misleading (0/3 meaning “idle” not “broken”), still ensure autonomy works AND clarify the UI label so Alex isn’t alarmed — but prefer real autonomy fix if something is actually gated off.
6. Phase catch-up: `cd "D:\.1 Work Stations\RootMC\Web Files\rootmc-ava" && node scripts/phase-catchup.mjs phase-discord-autonomy-on`
7. Short note if durable under `Server Handoffs/Ava Ivy/notes/`.

## Locks
- Ava Discord/Slack posts = bot token only, never Slack MCP for Ava voice
- No forced Shockbyte restart / no boats jar
- Minimal diffs
- Don’t derail the separate graphs/CPU/dashboard agent unless you must touch shared status page carefully — coordinate by not wiping their panels

Return: root cause, fix, status after restart (agents/asks/live).
</user_query>

input.contents:
# Ava surface architecture

**Discord (powered on + awake + Cursor key)** = autonomous Root Server digs. Mentions / replies / chimes run through gateway+poller → pipeline → Cursor agents (up to concurrency). No manual agent IDs needed.

**Discord (sleep / `AVA_FORCE_DREAM` / no Cursor key)** = dream state (cloud brain). Soft Slack pointer for heavy digs while dreaming.

**Slack** = staff dig home (Root Server on-device). Still preferred for long implement threads.

**Web** (rootmc.net / wiki) = communal organization + knowledge pages.

**Intentional offs** (unchanged):
- **QUIET / hush** — mute
- **Operator sleep** — dream summons only until ~10:00 HST
- **Power-down** — process off until human `npm start`
- **Cloud-dark** — silences Discord/Telegram only when dream is required (no Cursor); with Cursor up, Discord still answers

## Code
- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/recommend.mjs` — routes by power/sleep/forceDream + Cursor key
- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/surfaceRules.mjs` — Slack redirect only while asleep / no cursor
- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/dreamBrain.mjs` — sleep / fallback dream replies
- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/cursorBrain.mjs` — Root Server digs (Discord + Slack)
- `Web Files/rootmc-ava/src/opsPowerStatus.mjs` — EcoFlow / voting pack shortcut

## Status page
`Cursor digs 0/3 · idle` means free slots (not broken). Digging shows `1/3`…`3/3`.

## Test
Restart Ava. Ping Discord while live·hot → Root Server ask opens (`asks` / cursor digs bump). Sleep / QUIET still mute or dream-only.

# Discord autonomy on (powered-on Root Server) — 2026-08-02

## Root cause
Status `Agents 0/3` while `live · hot` looked broken, but Discord was **hard-locked to dream-only** in `recommend.mjs` (`discordDream = surface === discord`). Cursor slots never engaged for Discord asks. Pipeline also redirected digs → Slack and muted Discord under cloud-dark even with Cursor up.

## Fix
- Powered on + awake + `CURSOR_API_KEY` → Discord uses Root Server (local/Cursor agents up to concurrency).
- Dream reserved for sleep / `forceDream` / `AVA_FORCE_DREAM` / missing Cursor key.
- Slack dig redirect only while asleep / no cursor.
- Status label: **Cursor digs** `0/3 · idle` (idle ≠ broken).
- Hush / QUIET / sleep / power-down unchanged.

## Verify
`/api/status`: live·hot, cursor yes, digs idle until a Discord ask opens → asks/digs bump.

input.final_summary: Root cause: Discord was hard-locked to dream-only, so Cursor slots never engaged (0/3 looked broken). Fix: powered-on + awake + Cursor key → Discord uses Root Server again; dream only for sleep/forceDream/no key. content.text:
## Root cause
Discord was **hard-locked to dream-only** in `recommend.mjs` (`discordDream = surface === discord`). Cursor agents never ran for Discord asks, so **0/3 was idle-by-design**, not a dead concurrency knob. Digs were also bounced to Slack, and cloud-dark muted Discord even with Cursor up.

## Fix
When **powered on + awake + `CURSOR_API_KEY`**, Discord uses Root Server again (local/Cursor up to concurrency). Dream only for sleep / `forceDream` / `AVA_FORCE_DREAM` / missing key. Hush / QUIET / sleep / power-down unchanged. Status label: **Cursor digs 0/3 · idle** (idle ≠ broken).

## Status after restart
- **live · hot** · hush/sleep off · safe mode off  
- **Cursor digs 0/3 idle** · asks 0 · transport both · cursor yes  
- Single tree (index → server + poller)  
- Phase catch-up `phase-discord-autonomy-on` OK  
- GitHub push failed (Rootmcnet auth); local Ava commit present  

Note: `DISCORD-AUTONOMY-ON-2026-08-02.md` + updated `SURFACE-ARCHITECTURE.md`.
